findings.evidence: She had the safety chain off already.
findings.diagnosis: With the chain already off, Rennie reads as resolute-from-the-start; her central money-temptation plays as steeling herself rather than a live pull she must overcome.

findings.evidence: the way you paint a thing you love and cannot finish
findings.diagnosis: The narrator states the theme at first glance, outrunning what Rennie could infer from paint before touching the hull.
